subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as the canonical opt-in policy for bounding wedged deferred context-engine turn maintenance?
rationale: The code uses existing queue timeout machinery and has good proof, but it creates a new operator config surface and deliberately changes same-session maintenance timing when enabled, which needs maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout surface
options.body: Land this PR after the config-reference docs fix and treat the positive millisecond setting as the supported operator escape hatch for wedged background maintenance.

options.title: Define a different timeout policy first
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a default-on bound, a different config location, or recovery through diagnostics instead of a compaction setting.

options.title: Redirect overlapping work
options.body: Use this PR or a maintainer replacement as canonical, then close or retarget overlapping deferred-maintenance timeout PRs to avoid competing semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout surface
recommendation.body: Land this PR after the config-reference docs fix and treat the positive millisecond setting as the supported operator escape hatch for wedged background maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original background-maintenance feature and authored recent transcript/session seam work touched by the timeout fence.
